title: Start Lifting: Your First Four Weeks
audience: Adult beginners who have never followed a lifting programme and feel nervous in the gym.
brief: Give a safe, encouraging starter plan: form first, two full-body days a week, rest between sessions. Keep the tone welcoming so nervous beginners feel they belong. Goal: viewers download the free four-week starter workout PDF at lift.example/start.

issues.description: The opening spends about 20 seconds hedging and never states what the viewer will get; the actual plan is only announced after the intro.
Advises pushing through sharp joint pain, calling it 'weakness leaving the body'. Mainstream guidance is that sharp joint pain means stop the exercise and get checked, not push through.
Mocks beginners who use light weights ('if you are still on the pink two-kilo weights, do not bother showing up'), contradicting the brief's welcoming tone for nervous beginners.
The same warm-up routine is explained twice in a row, slowly and in full, with no new information, stalling the video for about 25 seconds.
The brief's goal is downloads of the free starter workout PDF, but the video ends with 'good luck, see you around' and never mentions the PDF.
